test BATCHED_POWER_SGD comm hook with NO, FP16, and BF16 wrappers
test FP16 comm hook with NO wrapper for gradient communication compression
test BF16 comm hook with NO wrapper for gradient communication compression
test that even_batches ensures uniform batch sizes across distributed processes
test disabling even_batches to allow different batch sizes per process
test joining uneven inputs with accelerator.join_uneven_inputs for DDP models
test stateful dataloader save and resume with load_state_dict for iterable and map-style datasets
test pickling and unpickling an Accelerator while preserving its state
test merging FSDP sharded model weights into a single safetensors file
test merging FSDP sharded model weights into a single pytorch bin file
test the merge CLI command to merge FSDP weights into safetensors format
test the merge CLI command to merge FSDP weights into pytorch bin format
test saving an FSDP model's sharded weights to disk for later merging
test the notebook_launcher function to launch a callable in distributed processes from a notebook
test the notebook_launcher with static and c10d rendezvous backends for multi-process distributed execution
test the notebook_launcher with max_restarts for fault-tolerant multi-process execution with retry logic
test the notebook_launcher with monitor_interval to detect and fail fast on process errors
test the PartialState class to initialize and query distributed process state in notebook environments
test the gather function to collect tensors from all distributed processes into a single tensor
test the gather_object function to collect Python objects from all distributed processes
test the gather function with non-contiguous tensors without raising errors
test the broadcast function to distribute a tensor from one process to all other processes
test the reduce function with sum operation across two distributed processes
test distributed training reproducibility with Accelerator across CPU and GPU setups using seedable samplers
test DataLoader preparation with Accelerator including shuffled, split, and dispatch batch configurations
test splitting lists, tensors, dicts, and datasets evenly across multiple distributed processes
test random number generator state synchronization across CPU, CUDA, XPU, and generator contexts
test process execution decorators and main_process_first context manager for multi-process orchestration
test the accelerator.no_sync context manager on a single CPU or GPU where it acts as a noop
test the accelerator.no_sync context manager in a distributed multi-GPU training setup
test accelerator.no_sync with multiple forward passes followed by multiple backward passes
test the accelerator.accumulate context manager with configurable split_batches, dispatch_batches, and sync_each_batch options
test gradient accumulation with optimizer and scheduler steps aligned across distributed processes
